The company owns nine properties in India at [[Ooty]], [[Burdwan]], [[Siliguri]], [[Darjeeling]], [[Kalimpong]], [[Dooars]], [[Port Blair]], [[Gangtok]], [[Udaipur]], and [[Haldighati]]. ==History and growth== The company was founded in 1971 as a private limited company by a local entrepreneur from [[Kolkata]]. The first hotel was set up in Siliguri in the year 1976. The next hotel was started in [[Darjeeling]] in 1981. The company made a public issue in the year 1986 and its shares were listed in [[Bombay Stock Exchange]] and Calcutta Stock Exchange. In 1990, Dr Niren Suchanti and Navin Suchanti acquired majority control of the company.{{cite web |url=http://www.indiainfoline.com/Research/LeaderSpeak/Navin-Suchanti-CEO-and-Managing-Director-Sinclairs-Hotels-Limited/34281016 |title=Interview of Navin Suchanti, CEO and Managing Director, Sinclairs Hotels Ltd. |publisher=indiainfoline.com |date=2012-06-11 |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20130902103146/http://www.indiainfoline.com/Research/LeaderSpeak/Navin-Suchanti-CEO-and-Managing-Director-Sinclairs-Hotels-Limited/34281016 |archive-date=2013-09-02 }} Navin Suchanti is the chairman and Dr Niren Suchanti is the director of the company.{{cite web |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/sinclairs-hotels-ltd/infocompanymanagement/companyid-12556.cms |title=Sinclairs Hotels Management Information|publisher=Economic Times }} Thereafter, the company acquired a hotel in [[Port Blair]] in 1991 and another one in Ooty in 1995. In 1999, it commissioned a resort property Sinclairs Retreat Dooars in Chalsa in the [[Dooars]] region of [[West Bengal]], [[India]].{{citation needed|date=June 2022}} In 2011, it acquired a majority stake in Savannah Hotels Pvt Ltd, which owns a 104-room hotel in [[Whitefield, Bangalore|Whitefield, Bengaluru]].{{cite news |url=http://www.thehindu.com/business/article2589258.ece |title=Sinclairs acquires majority stake in Savannah Hotels |work=The Hindu |date=2011-02-11 |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20131202231302/http://www.thehindu.com/business/article2589258.ece |archive-date=2013-12-02 }} In 2013, the company divested its investment in Savannah Hotels.{{cite news |url=https://www.indiainfoline.com/article/companies-announcements-bse/sinclairs-hotels-board-approves-divestment-of-2-holdings-in-savannah-hotels-114072819350_1.html |title=Sinclairs Hotels' Board approves divestment in Savannah Hotels |publisher=India Infoline|date=2013-03-23}} In 2014, Sinclairs commissioned its resort Sinclairs Retreat Kalimpong (46 rooms and 2 suites), in [[Kalimpong]] spread over an area of 5 acres.{{cite news |url=https://www.telegraphindia.com/business/sinclairs-bengal-plan/cid/171206 |title=Sinclairs looking to commission hotel project in Kalimpong and Burdwan |publisher=The Telegraph |date=2014-06-01 }} In 2015, Sinclairs commissioned its 4 acre resort in [[Burdwan]], Sinclairs Tourist Resort Burdwan.{{cite web |url=https://bwhotelier.businessworld.in/article/Sinclairs-opens-Resort-in-Burdwan-West-Bengal/30-12-2015-95197/ |title=Sinclairs opens Resort in Burdwan, West Bengal |publisher=BW Hotelier }} In 2020, Sinclairs launched its 8th property at [[Gangtok]], Sikkim (60 rooms and suites) with an area of 45,000 sq. ft.{{cite web |url=https://www.bseindia.com/xml-data/corpfiling/AttachHis/f220622f-9925-4dce-9e16-b584a659433b.pdf |title=Press release|date= 27 November 2020|website=www.bseindia.com |access-date=2021-04-14}} In 2021, Sinclairs Hotels signed an agreement to acquire on lease an 18-room property in [[Yangang]], Sikkim. This boutique hotel in South Sikkim is the ninth property under the brand Sinclairs.{{cite web |url=https://bwhotelier.businessworld.in/article/Sinclairs-adds-new-boutique-hotel-in-Yangang-Sikkim/13-12-2021-414600/|title=Sinclairs Hotels adds new boutique hotel in Sikkim|website=BW Hotelier}} In 2022, Seven properties of Sinclairs Hotels were awarded with [[TripAdvisor]] Travellers’ Choice Award on the basis of quality and quantity of traveller reviews and ratings.{{cite web |url=https://www.hotelierindia.com/operations/seven-sinclairs-properties-bag-the-tripadvisor-travellers-choice-award/|title= Seven Sinclairs properties bag the TripAdvisor Travellers' Choice Award 2022|website=Hotelier India}} ==Sinclairs Retreat, Ooty== At 8,000 feet (2.43 km) above sea level, the Sinclairs Retreat [[Ooty]] is the highest-located resort in South India. Due to the elevation and geography, Ooty has one of the most stable climates in all of India, with temperatures remaining cool year round, with an average yearly high around 20 °C (68 °F). in 2019, the Sinclairs Retreat Ooty was adjudged a winner of TripAdvisor's 2019 Travellers’ Choice Award, marking it as being in the top 1% of hotels worldwide according to reviews.[http://www.sinclairshotels.com/ooty= Sinclairs Retreat Ooty] ''Sinclairhotels.com'' The retreat features three restaurants, including a Spanish-themed bar and eatery, six event spaces ranging from ballrooms to scenic gardens and five styles of accommodation.[https://www.sinclairsindia.com/investor/press-releases/Sinclairs-Retreat-Ooty-winner-of-TripAdvisors-2019-Travellers-Choice-Award.pdf= TripAdvisors 2016 Travellers Choice Awards] ''sinclairsindia.com'' ==Sinclairs Retreat Kalimpong== Opened in 2015, the Sinclair Retreat [[Kalimpong]] is situated on five acres of land overlooking the [[Himalayas]]. The hotel features 48 rooms and suites including a steam-treated wooden cabin and loft apartments, each with a fireplace, balcony and garden, three restaurants and three function rooms. In 2018 the Sinclairs Retreat Kalimpong received the Booking.com Guest Review Award, averaging a user rating of 8.5 out of 10.[https://twitter.com/sinclairshotels/status/1084720287567015936= Booking.com Guest Review Award 2018] ''@sinclairshotels'' ==Sinclairs Bayview Port Blair== The Bayview is the only hotel in [[Port Blair]] to offer views of the [[Bay of Bengal]] from almost every room. Located on the [[Andaman Islands]], an archipelago in the Bay of Bengal between [[India]] and [[Myanmar]], the islands were occupied by Japanese forces for a short while during WWII. As such, the Sinclairs Bayview is built around a real Japanese bunker that patrons can explore. The hotel features 46 rooms, four restaurants and one function room. In 2016 the Sinclairs Bayview was ranked as the number one hotel in Port Blair by TripAdvisor.com.[http://www.ritzmagazine.in/sinclairs-bayview-ranked-no-1-hotel-in-port-blair-by-tripadvisor/= Sinclairs Bayview ranked No. 1 hotel in Port Blair by TripAdvisor] ''ritzmagazine.in'' ==References== {{Reflist}} [[Category:Hotel chains in India]] [[Category:1971 establishments in West Bengal]] [[Category:Indian companies established in 1971]] [[Category:Hospitality companies established in 1971]] [[Category:Companies listed on the Bombay Stock Exchange]]
